title: Antibonding node
statement:
What feature distinguishes an antibonding combination of two aligned 1s orbitals?

[_]{a}

choices: A density maximum between the nuclei
No possibility of holding any electron
Two separate molecular orbitals of identical shape and energy
explanations: Destructive overlap reduces electron density there.
This is typical of the bonding combination.

hints: The component phases subtract between nuclei.
Look for zero wavefunction between the atoms.
The resulting orbital is labeled with an asterisk.
solution: The component phases subtract between nuclei. Look for zero wavefunction between the atoms. The resulting orbital is labeled with an asterisk. Destructive overlap reduces electron density there.
